title: This Bird Builds an Optical Illusion to Win a Mate
subject: great bowerbird

scenes.text: This bird builds an optical illusion to win a mate.
The male great bowerbird lays out a courtyard of stones and bones in front of his bower.
He puts the small stones close to the female's viewing spot and the bigger ones farther away.
From the avenue, everything looks about the same size, and the court seems smaller and him more impressive.
It's forced perspective, the same trick film makers use.
In a study of twenty males, only those who got the illusion right won mates.

description:
This bird builds an optical illusion to win a mate.
Researchers at Deakin University found males arrange stones so the court looks smaller and the male bigger, and only the best illusions won mates.
What is the strangest courtship you know?
